p3_b0.ocr: In the context of sustainable mining practices, the rehabilitation and closure provisions are crucial for ensuring compliance with environmental regulations and promoting responsible resource management. Within this report, we present a detailed overview of the financial commitments related to these provisions, particularly focusing on closure costs.

p3_b1.ocr: The data illustrates a projected amount of £150M earmarked for closure costs, reflecting a strategic increase in our rehabilitation efforts as we approach 2024. This aligns with our objective to enhance operational sustainability and mitigate environmental impact. Notably, the table indicates a %Change of "Increase," highlighting our commitment to improving our performance in this area.
